bifrost: none on-device. Remote model clients only: springboard/apps/daw/src/ai.rs, springboard/apps/assistant-desktop/src/model.rs. Text prediction is a word list, not a model: springboard/apps/keyboard/src/predict.rs
summary: Core AI runs specialized models on Apple silicon (CPU, GPU, Neural Engine) with model assets, cached specialization, inference functions and tensor types. BifrOSt has no on-device inference runtime and no tensor or compute API for apps. Its AI features call the Anthropic cloud API, and its predictive text is a trie with bigrams.

features.apple: AIModel, AIModelAsset (Core AI landing page, Essentials)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 4 (theme-13, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No model loading or inference path in springboard/sdk/src/ or springboard/src/. Cloud calls only: springboard/apps/daw/src/ai.rs (Anthropic Messages API, key from the opencode auth store).

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Nothing in the repo describes a typed model signature.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs (fit, cover, contain); springboard/render/src/cg/imageio/mod.rs (PNG and JPEG decode)
features.note: PNG and JPEG decode to 8-bit pixels and the screen fitting helpers are tested headless in springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-07-w7.rs. Gap: there is no descriptor for passing pixels to a model.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 3 (theme-13, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The GPU presenter in springboard/src/gpu/ serves rendering only, and no SDK type exposes asynchronous compute work.
The Neural Engine is Apple hardware. No counterpart on the Linux PC.
The options name CPU, GPU and Neural Engine units. The PC has no Neural Engine, so there is nothing to choose between.

features.apple: AIModelCache, managing model specialization and caching
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 4 (theme-13, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The SDK has a generic cache at springboard/sdk/src/ (see docs/bifrost-ui.md, cache), but nothing stores specialized model artifacts.

features.apple: coreai-build command-line tool, compiling Core AI models ahead of time
features.note: compile checks the widths of an operator chain and serializes a canonical plan per target, and prepare reuses the artifact through the specialization cache (headless tests in ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-37.rs). Gap: there is no model importer and no kernel generation, and the cache is not wired into the shell or apps or measured on Midget.

features.apple: Debug gauge, Instruments, Core AI Debugger
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. General logging and performance tooling exist (tools/bench.py). Nothing traces inference or tensor values.

features.apple: Not a Core AI feature. Relates to Foundation Models and language models
features.bifrost: springboard/apps/keyboard/src/predict.rs (prefix trie, bigram bonus, edit-distance-1 autocorrect)
features.note: Prediction runs on-device but uses frequency lists, not a neural model. The Assistant app (springboard/apps/assistant-desktop/src/model.rs) sends its requests to the cloud.
The error type belongs to Core AI's asset pipeline, which BifrOSt does not have.

gaps: No on-device model runtime (load, specialize, run) for apps in the SDK or the system layer.
No compute stream API for apps, so GPU or CPU inference cannot be offloaded from an app.
No model cache or ahead-of-time compile step.
No inference-level profiling or tracing in the debug tools.
The AI features (daw/ai.rs, assistant model.rs) depend on the cloud API, not local inference.
